comparison.objective: Seat opposed tapered shims behind a door jamb without excessive bow.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual wedge insertion and force-balanced positioning from opposite wall faces.
comparison.success_condition: Opposed shims overlap, leave no more than 0.05 mm free space, limit jamb bow, and remain at rest after release.
comparison.reason: Wedge packing against compliant jamb geometry does not test socket reacquisition, collar locking, or iterative dynamic damping.
